what: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: Documentation: https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/. R package named ukhsadatR: use library(ukhsadatR) installing. wrapper UKHSA Data Dashboard API, data can easily imported R. detailed documentation UKHSA data dashboard API available . package based upon ukcovid19 package previously published Public Health England substantially rewritten extended. NB: fork specially adapted AMR data. well Data Dashboard API, wraps UKHSA Fingertips “AMR local indicators” profile (antibiotic prescribing, resistance, bacteraemia / C. difficile case counts, stewardship) via fingertipsR package. See Fingertips AMR local indicators.

title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: argument get_data() can "*" (every value), glob pattern "NHS*London*", vector values. Every matching dataset downloaded stacked one table, can saved time: Preview query download, without downloading , get_combinations() (arguments).
code: ecoli <- get_data(   theme = "infectious_disease",   sub_theme = "antimicrobial_resistance",   topic = "E-coli",   geography_type = "Integrated Care Board",   geography = "*",   metric = "*PercentResistant*",   as_data_table = TRUE,   save_to = "ecoli_icb_resistance.csv" )

title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: Requests throttled 1 per second default retried backoff API returns 429 (many requests). wildcard query N datasets therefore takes least N seconds. Change rate options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = 0.5). get_data() refuses queries matching max_datasets (default 500) datasets unless raise limit manually.

title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: get_subtheme_data() runs get_data() per sub-theme (topics, geographies metrics) optionally saves one file per sub-theme. default fetches ten sub-themes infectious_disease, UKHSA region (nation contact vector_borne, published nationally):
code: # everything, one CSV per sub-theme (a long download) get_subtheme_data(out_dir = "ukhsa_data")  # just two sub-themes, in memory x <- get_subtheme_data(sub_themes = c("respiratory", "gastrointestinal")) names(x)  # override the geography type for one sub-theme get_subtheme_data(sub_themes = c("respiratory", "contact"),                   geography_type = c(respiratory = "Nation"))

title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: download_fingertips_amr() retrieves every indicator Fingertips profile 101 available area types (GP practice, Sub-ICB, ICB, trust, CCG, STP, region, England), un-aggregated numerator (count) denominator columns. row tagged theme, whether series rolling (is_rolling, period_type), organism / specimen / onset, parsed period_start / period_end dates. Themes prescribing, resistance, testing, cases, stewardship, ipc ; rolling "include", "exclude" "". Rolling series un-rolled without starting values, “rolling quarterly average” series report 4-quarter average count (rounded), use rolling = "exclude" need discrete counts.
code: # Discrete (non-rolling) resistance series, in memory res <- download_fingertips_amr(themes = "resistance", rolling = "exclude")  # Everything, cached and resumable on disk (re-run to retry failures) amr <- download_fingertips_amr(out_dir = "data/fingertips_amr")  attr(amr, "download_log")      # status / rows / seconds per indicator summarise_fingertips_coverage(amr)  # See what would be fetched without downloading any data fingertips_amr_indicators(themes = c("prescribing", "resistance"))

title: R Interface to Access UKHSA Dashboard Data
text: OpenPrescribing API (Bennett Institute, University Oxford; keyless) serves monthly items, quantity actual cost BNF code NHS Business Services Authority prescribing dataset, last five years. get_op_spending() retrieves spatial resolution choose: "england", "region", "icb", "sicbl" (Sub-ICB Location), "pcn" "practice". code matched BNF prefix ("0501" = antibacterials; section numbers "5.1.1" also work). Several codes fetched separately returned long format code_label column unless combine = TRUE. get_op_org_details() returns list-size denominators directly. Organisations OpenPrescribing currently defines, series follow past ICB / Sub-ICB mergers; check org_id matches boundary vintage. requests share package’s rate limit (see ).
code: # Antibacterials (BNF 5.1), England, monthly get_op_spending("0501")  # Named classes by ICB for 2024, with items per 1,000 registered patients get_op_spending(   c(Penicillins = "050101", Macrolides = "050105"),   resolution = "icb", start = "2024-01", end = "2024-12",   add_list_size = TRUE )  # Every BNF 5.1 sub-class (13 requests) at region level get_op_antibiotics(resolution = "region", start = "2023-01")  # Find BNF and organisation codes, and get boundaries for mapping search_op_bnf("amoxicillin") search_op_org("london", resolution = "icb") icb <- get_op_boundaries("icb")          # sf object (needs the 'sf' package)

title: Classify Fingertips indicators from their names — classify_fingertips_indicators
text: data.frame one row per name columns: is_rolling logical; name mentions rolling window. period_type one "12-month rolling, monthly steps", "rolling 4-quarter average, quarterly steps", "financial year", "calendar year", "quarter", "month", "year (see definition)", "unspecified". theme one "prescribing", "resistance", "testing", "cases", "stewardship", "ipc", "". organism e.g. "E. coli", NA. specimen "blood", "urine" NA. onset "hospital-onset", "community-onset" NA.

what: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
text: Retrieves every indicator UKHSA Fingertips "AMR local indicators" profile (profile 101) fingertipsR: antibiotic prescribing, antimicrobial resistance, bacteraemia / C. difficile case counts, susceptibility testing, stewardship infection prevention control. Data fetched available area types (GP practice, Sub-ICB, ICB, trust, CCG, STP, region, England) kept un-aggregated, numerator (count) denominator columns, discrete (non-rolling) series can analysed directly. count denominator NA UKHSA disclosure control suppresses small numbers.

title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
code: download_fingertips_amr(   themes = "all",   rolling = c("include", "exclude", "only"),   out_dir = NULL,   refresh = FALSE,   profile_id = .fingertips_profile_id,   max_tries = 3L,   retry_wait = 5,   pause = 0.5,   as_data_table = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
text: themes character vector themes download: "prescribing", "resistance", "testing", "cases", "stewardship", "ipc", "", "" (default). rolling "include" (default) downloads rolling discrete series, "exclude" drops rolling series, "" keeps rolling series. out_dir optional output directory (created needed). See section files written. NULL (default) keeps everything memory. refresh TRUE, re-download indicators even cached file exists out_dir. profile_id Fingertips profile ID; default, 101, "AMR local indicators - produced UKHSA". max_tries number attempts per indicator recorded failed. retry_wait seconds wait failed attempt, multiplied attempt number. pause seconds wait indicators, polite API. as_data_table TRUE, return data.table rather data.frame. verbose show progress messages.

title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
text: combined long table (data.frame, data.table as_data_table = TRUE), two attributes: attr(x, "catalogue") (selected indicators) attr(x, "download_log") (status, rows seconds per indicator). Attributes dropped subsetting, keep reference full object, read files out_dir. NULL (invisibly) returned indicator matches selection; empty data.frame, warning, every download failed.

title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
text: Every indicator first classified name (see classify_fingertips_indicators), time-period labels parsed dates (see parse_fingertips_period). result one long table columns: indicator_id, indicator_name, area_code, area_name, area_type, parent_code, parent_name, timeperiod, value, count, denominator, ci95_lower, ci95_upper, parsed period_start, period_end (12-month rolling series) window_start, classification columns theme, organism, specimen, onset, is_rolling, period_type, Domains, area_org_code: NHS organisation (ODS) code parsed end Sub-ICB / ICB names (GPs trusts area_code already ODS code). Verify area_org_code lookup joining . columns returned fingertipsR kept unchanged. Downloads slow (one API call sequence per indicator) therefore cached resumable out_dir given: indicator stored <out_dir>/raw/indicator_<ID>.rds skipped next call unless refresh = TRUE. call interrupted indicators fail, simply run .

what: Files written when out_dir is supplied
title: Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators — download_fingertips_amr
text: indicator_catalogue.csv one row per indicator profile (themes, regardless themes): theme, rolling flag, period type, organism / specimen tags, domains UKHSA metadata. raw/indicator_<ID>.rds cached per-indicator download. download_log.csv status, rows seconds per indicator. fingertips_amr_long.rds, fingertips_amr_long.csv.gz combined table, returned. indicator_coverage.csv summarise_fingertips_coverage. default out_dir = NULL nothing written disk nothing cached calls.

what: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
text: Returns catalogue indicators UKHSA Fingertips "AMR local indicators" profile (profile 101), one row per indicator, full UKHSA metadata classification classify_fingertips_indicators. indicator data downloaded, quick way see download_fingertips_amr fetch.

title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
code: fingertips_amr_indicators(   themes = "all",   rolling = c("include", "exclude", "only"),   profile_id = .fingertips_profile_id )

title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
text: themes character vector themes keep: "prescribing", "resistance", "testing", "cases", "stewardship", "ipc", "", "" (default). rolling "include" (default) keeps every indicator, "exclude" drops rolling series, "" keeps rolling series. profile_id Fingertips profile ID. default, 101, "AMR local indicators - produced UKHSA".

title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
text: data.frame one row per indicator.

title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
text: Requires fingertipsR package, currently CRAN: pak::pak("ropensci/fingertipsR").

title: List the indicators in the Fingertips AMR profile — fingertips_amr_indicators
code: # \donttest{ if (requireNamespace("fingertipsR", quietly = TRUE)) {   cat_tbl <- fingertips_amr_indicators(themes = "resistance", rolling = "exclude")   head(cat_tbl[, c("IndicatorID", "IndicatorName", "period_type")]) } #>   IndicatorID #> 1       92519 #> 2       92521 #>                                                                                                  IndicatorName #> 1   Percentage of community E. coli urine specimens resistant to trimethoprim; by ICB sub-location and quarter #> 2 Percentage of community E. coli urine specimens resistant to nitrofurantoin; by ICB sub-location and quarter #>   period_type #> 1     quarter #> 2     quarter # }

title: Get Combinations — get_combinations
text: Lists theme / sub_theme / topic / geography_type / geography / metric combinations match query, without downloading data. Use explore available, check many datasets wildcard query get_data download.

title: Get Combinations — get_combinations
code: get_combinations(   theme = "*",   sub_theme = NULL,   topic = NULL,   geography_type = NULL,   geography = NULL,   metric = NULL,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Get Combinations — get_combinations
text: theme largest overall topical subgroup data. example infectious_disease. sub_theme topical subgroup associated parent theme. example respiratory. topic categorical subgroup associated selected theme sub_theme. example, COVID-19. geography_type overarching area type intended geography. example Nation. geography selected area geography_type. example England. metric type data selected. example COVID-19_testing_PCRcountByDay. verbose show progress messages.

title: Get Combinations — get_combinations
code: data.frame with one row per matching combination,                    or \code{NULL} (invisibly) if the query could not be                    resolved, in which case the available options are                    shown as a message.

title: Get Combinations — get_combinations
text: argument accepts single value, character vector values, "*" every available value, glob pattern containing * ? (example "NHS*London*"). Resolution stops last argument supplied, get_combinations(theme = "*", sub_theme = "*") lists every sub-theme every theme without looking hierarchy.

code: get_data(   theme = NULL,   sub_theme = NULL,   topic = NULL,   geography_type = NULL,   geography = NULL,   metric = NULL,   save_to = NULL,   as_data_table = FALSE,   max_datasets = 500,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Get Data — get_data
text: theme largest overall topical subgroup data. example infectious_disease. sub_theme topical subgroup associated parent theme. example respiratory. topic categorical subgroup associated selected theme sub_theme. example, COVID-19. geography_type overarching area type intended geography. example Nation. geography selected area geography_type. example England. metric type data selected. example COVID-19_testing_PCRcountByDay. save_to optional file path. supplied, combined result also written disk: .rds files saveRDS(), anything else (e.g. .csv, .csv.gz) data.table::fwrite(). as_data_table TRUE, return data.table; otherwise (default) data.frame. max_datasets safety limit number metric datasets wildcard query may download. Raise deliberately broad queries. verbose show progress messages.

title: Get Data — get_data
code: data.frame (or data.table) containing the query                    results.

title: Get Data — get_data
text: Every query argument accepts: single exact value, e.g. "E-coli"; character vector values, e.g. c("England", "Wales"); "*" download every available value level; glob pattern using * ?, e.g. "NHS*London*" "*PercentResistant*". Wildcards can used level, including theme sub_theme. Every matching combination downloaded results stacked data.table::rbindlist(). row keeps theme, topic, geography, metric, etc. columns, combined table self-describing. Use get_combinations first see many datasets wildcard query download. information UKHSA dashboard API please visit API documentation.
code: If any argument is left \code{NULL} or is invalid,                    the possible values for that argument are shown as a                    message and \code{NULL} is returned invisibly.                    Datasets that fail to download are skipped with a                    message; the rest are still returned.

title: Get Data — get_data
text: requests throttled getOption("ukhsadatR.requests_per_second", 1) retried backoff HTTP 429/503, wildcard query N datasets takes least N seconds default. Lists available options cached session (see clear_cache). Please keep broad queries proportionate: preview get_combinations.

what: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics
title: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics
text: convenience wrapper around get_op_spending retrieves one series per antibacterial class BNF section 5.1 (see op_antibiotic_classes) spatial resolution choose.

title: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics
code: get_op_antibiotics(classes = NULL, include_total = FALSE, ...)

title: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics
text: classes classes fetch: NULL (default) thirteen sub-sections 5.1.1-5.1.13, character vector section numbers ("5.1.5"), BNF codes ("050105") class names ("Macrolides", case-insensitive). include_total logical. Also fetch section 5.1 series (code "0501"). overlaps classes, sum . ... passed get_op_spending: resolution, org, date, start, end, add_list_size, as_data_table, verbose.

title: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics
text: get_op_spending, class name code_label. Costs one request per class (13 default).

title: Get antibiotic prescribing by BNF class from OpenPrescribing — get_op_antibiotics

what: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
title: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
text: Downloads geographic boundaries (centroids / locations) OpenPrescribing holds organisations, ready join get_op_spending results org_id == code mapping.

title: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
code: get_op_boundaries(   resolution = "icb",   org = NULL,   centroids = FALSE,   as = c("sf", "geojson") )

title: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
text: resolution one "region", "icb", "sicbl", "pcn", "practice". org optional character vector organisation codes keep. centroids logical; return centroids instead polygons (honoured Sub-ICB Locations). "sf" (default; needs sf package) "geojson" raw GeoJSON text.

title: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
text: sf object EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) columns name, code geometry column, GeoJSON string.

title: Get organisation boundaries from OpenPrescribing — get_op_boundaries
text: Region, ICB PCN boundaries unions underlying Sub-ICB (practice) boundaries, consistent OpenPrescribing organisation hierarchy may differ slightly ONS generalised boundaries. Practices returned points.

what: Get list sizes and prescribing units from OpenPrescribing — get_op_org_details
title: Get list sizes and prescribing units from OpenPrescribing — get_op_org_details
text: Monthly organisation statistics OpenPrescribing org_details endpoint, mainly registered patient list size used denominator prescribing rates. get_op_spending can add add_list_size = TRUE.

title: Get list sizes and prescribing units from OpenPrescribing — get_op_org_details
code: get_op_org_details(   resolution = "england",   org = NULL,   keys = "total_list_size",   date = NULL,   start = NULL,   end = NULL,   as_data_table = FALSE )

title: Get list sizes and prescribing units from OpenPrescribing — get_op_org_details
text: resolution, org, date, start, end, as_data_table get_op_spending. Without org, every organisation resolution returned whole five-year window, large download "practice" level. keys character vector statistics return: "total_list_size", "astro_pu_items", "astro_pu_cost" "star_pu.<name>" key listed OpenPrescribing API documentation.

what: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: Retrieves monthly prescribing items, quantity actual cost (GBP) one BNF codes OpenPrescribing API, aggregated spatial resolution choose. data NHS England primary-care (mainly GP) prescriptions dispensed community, English Prescribing Dataset; API holds recent five years.

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
code: get_op_spending(   code,   resolution = "england",   org = NULL,   date = NULL,   start = NULL,   end = NULL,   combine = FALSE,   add_list_size = FALSE,   as_data_table = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: code character vector BNF codes section numbers (see Details). Optionally named set labels. resolution spatial resolution: one "england" (default), "region", "icb", "sicbl", "pcn", "practice". org optional character vector organisation codes keep (example ICB codes). resolution = "practice" Sub-ICB code expands practices. NULL (default) returns every organisation resolution. Find codes search_op_org. date optional month(s) return: Date objects "YYYY-MM-DD" / "YYYY-MM" strings. day rounded first month. start, end optional first last month (inclusive) date; either may given alone. combinable date. combine logical. TRUE, codes summed single request (API treats multiple codes union) returned one series. Beware double counting codes overlap. add_list_size logical. TRUE, also fetch get_op_org_details add total_list_size items_per_1000 (items per 1,000 registered patients). as_data_table logical; return data.table. verbose logical; message number requests large.

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: data.frame one row per month organisation (code): date first day month (Date). resolution canonical resolution requested. org_id, org_name organisation code name (NA / "england" national totals). code, code_label BNF code (comma-joined codes combine) label. items number prescription items. quantity total quantity dispensed (units depend presentation, compare within product). actual_cost actual cost GBP. Practice-level results add parent_sicbl setting (practice setting code; 4 standard GP practice). add_list_size, columns total_list_size items_per_1000 appended. Months prescribing organisation omitted API, returned zero.

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: "england" one national series (default). "region" NHS England regions (API's regional_team). "icb" Integrated Care Boards (API's stp). "sicbl" Sub-ICB Locations (API's ccg). "pcn" Primary Care Networks. "practice" individual GP practices. "stp", "ccg", "sub-icb" "regional_team" accepted aliases. Organisations currently defined OpenPrescribing: practice prescribing attributed organisation practice belongs now, series follow past mergers boundary changes. Check org_id values match boundary vintage plan join .

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: code matched prefix, "0501" covers BNF section 5.1 (antibacterial drugs) "0501013B0" single chemical. Section numbers "5.1" "5.1.1" also accepted. supply several codes fetched separately (one API request ) returned long format code column, unless combine = TRUE. Names code become code_label column. Find codes search_op_bnf op_antibiotic_classes.

title: Get prescribing totals from OpenPrescribing — get_op_spending
text: National organisation-level queries need one request per code. API return practices months one call, resolution = "practice" without org needs date start end sends one request per code per month. requests throttled getOption("ukhsadatR.requests_per_second", 1).

what: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
title: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
text: Runs get_data per sub-theme (topics, geographies metrics one geography type) optionally saves result file. defaults retrieves ten sub-themes infectious_disease (antimicrobial resistance, bloodborne, bloodstream infection, childhood illness, contact, gastrointestinal, invasive bacterial infections, respiratory, vaccine-preventable vector-borne).

title: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
code: get_subtheme_data(   sub_themes = NULL,   theme = "infectious_disease",   topic = "*",   geography_type = NULL,   geography = "*",   metric = "*",   out_dir = NULL,   format = c("csv", "csv.gz", "rds"),   as_data_table = FALSE,   max_datasets = 1e+05,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
text: sub_themes character vector sub-themes. NULL (default) means ten known infectious_disease sub-themes. Values containing * ? expanded API, "*" fetches every sub-theme API lists theme. theme theme, default "infectious_disease". topic, geography, metric passed get_data; default "*" (everything). geography_type geography type retrieve. NULL (default) uses "Nation" contact vector_borne sub-themes, published nationally, "UKHSA Region" everything else. Supply single value use sub-themes, named vector (e.g. c(respiratory = "Nation")) override individual sub-themes. out_dir optional directory. supplied, sub-theme saved <out_dir>/<sub_theme>.<format>. format file format used out_dir supplied: "csv" (default), "csv.gz" "rds". as_data_table TRUE, return data.tables rather data.frames. max_datasets passed get_data; per-sub-theme safety limit number metric datasets. default generous whole sub-theme can contain thousands datasets. verbose show progress messages.

title: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
text: named list one element per sub-theme: data.frame (data.table), NULL sub-theme retrieved. Returns NULL invisibly sub_themes contained patterns resolved.

title: Download every sub-theme of a UKHSA dashboard theme — get_subtheme_data
text: large download, issued rate set options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = ) (default one request per second), takes long time. Preview single sub-theme's size first get_combinations, use sub_themes fetch need. Sub-themes fail resolve download skipped message, rest still returned.

title: BNF antibacterial drug classes (BNF section 5.1) — op_antibiotic_classes
text: sub-sections BNF chapter 5, section 1 ("Antibacterial drugs"), BNF codes get_op_spending accepts. Use pick classes get_op_antibiotics.

title: BNF antibacterial drug classes (BNF section 5.1) — op_antibiotic_classes
code: op_antibiotic_classes()

title: BNF antibacterial drug classes (BNF section 5.1) — op_antibiotic_classes
text: data.frame columns number (BNF section number, e.g. "5.1.1"), code (BNF code prefix, e.g. "050101") class. first row whole section 5.1.

title: BNF antibacterial drug classes (BNF section 5.1) — op_antibiotic_classes
text: classes follow BNF's grouping, drug class use rather AWaRe category, ATC group UKHSA/ESPAUR definitions, classes straddle (example 5.1.7 5.1.13 mix agents). Section 5.1.9 (antituberculosis) 5.1.10 (antileprotic) included completeness normally excluded community antibiotic-stewardship analyses. BNF classification revised time; confirm code rely search_op_bnf.

what: Search BNF codes in OpenPrescribing — search_op_bnf

text: Looks BNF chapters, sections, paragraphs, chemicals, products presentations name code, find code give get_op_spending.

title: Search BNF codes in OpenPrescribing — search_op_bnf
code: search_op_bnf(q, exact = FALSE)

title: Search BNF codes in OpenPrescribing — search_op_bnf
text: q character vector search terms: part name (case insensitive, e.g. "amoxicillin") start code ("0501", "5.1"). Results several terms combined. exact logical; TRUE exact code name matches returned.

title: Search BNF codes in OpenPrescribing — search_op_bnf

what: Search NHS organisations in OpenPrescribing — search_op_org

text: Finds organisation codes give org argument get_op_spending.

title: Search NHS organisations in OpenPrescribing — search_op_org
code: search_op_org(q = NULL, resolution = NULL, exact = FALSE)

title: Search NHS organisations in OpenPrescribing — search_op_org
text: q character vector search terms: start code, part name (practices also match postcode). NULL lists every organisation given resolution. resolution optional single resolution ("region", "icb", "sicbl", "pcn", "practice") search within. NULL searches Sub-ICB Locations practices. exact logical; require exact code name match.

title: Search NHS organisations in OpenPrescribing — search_op_org
text: data.frame least id, code, name type; practices also postcode, setting, setting_name ccg (Sub-ICB code). Searching practices (q = NULL) returns several thousand rows.

title: ukhsadatR (development version)
text: get_op_spending() returns monthly items, quantity actual cost BNF code(s) England, region, ICB, Sub-ICB Location, PCN practice resolution, date / start / end filtering, long-format output several named codes, combine, add_list_size items per 1,000 patients. get_op_antibiotics() op_antibiotic_classes() fetch BNF 5.1 antibacterial sub-classes. get_op_org_details() returns list sizes, ASTRO-PU STAR-PU; search_op_bnf() search_op_org() look codes; get_op_boundaries() returns organisation boundaries sf (sf suggested package). Requests use existing rate limit retry settings. Offline tests mock API; opt-live tests test-live.R.

title: ukhsadatR 0.3.0
text: retrieval scripts scripts/ now documented, exported functions ordinary arguments instead command-line flags, can used project installing package. New get_subtheme_data() (scripts/retrieve_all.R) downloads every sub-theme theme (default: ten infectious_disease sub-themes), optionally saving one file per sub-theme. New download_fingertips_amr() (scripts/fingertips_amr_download.R) downloads Fingertips “AMR local indicators” profile area types, per-indicator caching resumption out_dir given. Command-line options map arguments: --themes themes, --rolling rolling, --out_dir --refresh refresh. Unlike script keeps everything memory out_dir NULL longer needs dplyr readr. New helpers fingertips_amr_indicators(), classify_fingertips_indicators(), parse_fingertips_period() summarise_fingertips_coverage(). fingertipsR (CRAN) suggested package, installed pak::pak("ropensci/fingertipsR"). Fixed get_data() failing “subscript bounds” one several datasets downloaded; failed dataset now skipped documented. Offline test suite: API mocked, tests longer need network access. live tests opt-(UKHSADATR_LIVE_TESTS=true).

title: ukhsadatR 0.2.0
text: get_data() now supports wildcards: argument can "*" (values), glob pattern "NHS*London*", character vector values. matching datasets downloaded combined data.table::rbindlist(). New save_to argument get_data() writes combined result .csv / .csv.gz (via data.table::fwrite()) .rds. New as_data_table argument returns data.table instead data.frame. New max_datasets safety limit broad wildcard queries. New get_combinations() lists datasets query matches without downloading . requests now rate limited (default 1 request/second, set options(ukhsadatR.requests_per_second = ...)) retried exponential backoff HTTP 429/502/503/504, honouring Retry-. Catalogue lookups (available themes, topics, geographies, metrics) cached session; clear_cache() resets .
